name: GitHub
short: GitHub Copilot subscriptions, bundling first-party MAI-Code models with Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok and Kimi under GitHub AI Credits.

plans.name: GitHub Models (Free Prototyping API)
plans.notes: Instant OpenAI-compatible API key via GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT). Free rate-limited inference (15 RPM / 150 RPD) for prototyping across GPT-4o, Llama, and Phi models locally.

plans.name: Copilot Free
plans.notes: Limited IDE chat and code agent usage; 2,000 completions and 50 chat requests per month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $15/month of GitHub AI Credits ($10 base + $5 flex); unlimited completions; 1 credit = $0.01.

plans.name: Pro+
plans.notes: $70/month of GitHub AI Credits ($39 base + $31 flex); delegate tasks to third-party coding agents.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: $200/month of GitHub AI Credits ($100 base + $100 flex) for sustained agent workflows.
